description: Examples only. Select backend_url explicitly in gateway.json. Do not expose Comfy or gateway on 0.0.0.0. No automatic connection, credentials or cloud upload.

remote_gateway_example.description: Run gateway and assets on remote GPU host; forward client18190 to remote8190 and client18188 to remote8188. Explicit server-side gateway.json additions only; not enabled by this example.

requirements: The backend needs the same fixed workflows, models and Media Studio nodes.
Current input/output and prepared MV projects are local to this root; an SSH tunnel alone does not synchronize assets or outputs. Remote media transfer is not implemented.
Resource measurements describe this gateway host. A forwarded remote PID cannot be verified locally; its process metrics remain unknown/advisory.
Existing Codex/DSH MCP launch profiles are independent and unchanged.
